prompt.en: The Green Page is hiding in the leaves. Can you find it?
prompt.ar: الصَّفْحَةُ الخَضْرَاءُ مُخْتَبِئَةٌ بَيْنَ الأَوْرَاق. هَلْ تَجِدُهَا؟

hint2.en: It is lower down, not up in the sky.
hint2.ar: إِنَّهَا فِي الأَسْفَل، لَيْسَتْ فِي السَّمَاء.

model.en: There it is. Touch it and it is yours.

payload._comment: Positions are whole percentages of the scene box, so one authored scene works on a phone, a tablet and in landscape. Hidden-object scenes do NOT mirror in Arabic: a painted jungle is a picture, not a line of text.
